backToProfile: Back to “How you want to build”
title: Values and trade-offs
intro: Some decisions are hard because two important things can both be right at the same time. In four situations you can look at what would matter more to you in this venture.

points.noRight: There are no right or wrong answers.
points.thisVenture: Your answers apply to this venture.
points.optional: This is optional and independent of whether you have completed the venture questionnaire.
points.private: Only you see your answers – unless you later choose to share them for the team comparison.

legacy.title: You have answered similar situations before.
legacy.text: Would you like to use your earlier answers as a starting point? You can review and change them. Nothing is submitted until you do it yourself.
legacy.take: Use my earlier answers as a starting point

from.legacy: Your earlier answers from the venture questionnaire are shown here as a starting point. Review them and change whatever is different today.
from.previous: Your last submission is shown here as a starting point. Review it and change whatever is different today.

flow.submitHint: Once all four situations are answered, you can submit. “I can’t decide that yet” is a valid answer.

errors.generic: This could not be submitted. Your answers are saved – please try again in a moment.

flow.privacyNote: Only for you. Submitting shares nothing. Only afterwards you decide whether your team may see this run in the comparison.

result.title: Your answers
result.intro: These are your weightings and paths in the four situations, as you gave them. They are conversation starters, not an assessment.
result.private: Visible to you – in the team comparison only if you share it.
result.noAnswer: There is no answer for this situation.
result.updateHint: Your last submission stays valid until you submit a new version.
result.draftTitle: A new run is in progress
result.draftText: Your last submission stays valid until you submit the new one.

statement.weights_equal: Both aspects were equally important to you ({level}).
statement.weights_more_high: Here “{more}” mattered more to you, although “{less}” was also {lessLevel}.
statement.path: As a first path, you would choose “{path}”.
statement.path_other: As a first path, you would choose something else.
statement.path_unknown: Which path you would choose first is still open for you.
statement.path_against_weight: You would take the first path at “{pathConcern}”, even though “{more}” mattered more to you.

errors.setup_missing: This deepening is not set up in this environment yet.
errors.no_permission: You do not have permission for this.
errors.draft_create_failed: This could not be created. Please try again.
errors.unreachable: Not reachable right now. Please try again in a moment.
errors.not_submitted: Sharing is possible only after you have submitted.
errors.share_rejected: This sharing is not possible. There may be a newer run.
errors.share_failed: That did not work just now. Please try again shortly.

share.title: Team comparison
share.revokeConfirm: If you withdraw the sharing, the joint comparison may temporarily disappear for the team. Your own answers stay visible to you.
share.on: You have shared this run for the team comparison.
share.off: Sharing is withdrawn. Your run is private again.
share.missing: Some requirements for the joint comparison are still missing.

explain.p1: Your shared run can only appear in the joint comparison once all current team members have also completed this deepening and shared theirs.
explain.p2: Until then nobody sees your answers in the team comparison.
explain.p3: You can withdraw the sharing at any time.
explain.p4: Sharing applies to this run only. If you answer again later, you decide again.

share.olderActive: An earlier version of yours is still shared for the team comparison. This newer version is only yours until you explicitly share it.

team.title: Explore together
team.text: Optional deepenings for the whole team. A joint comparison only appears once all current members have completed and shared – until then nobody sees anything from the others.
team.not_started: You have not done this deepening yet.
team.completed: You have completed it. Your run is visible only to you.

compare.title: Values and trade-offs in the team
compare.intro: This is how you weighted four situations and which first path each of you would choose – as each person stated it. Differences are conversation starters; agreement is not an assessment. All current members see the same comparison.
compare.notReadyTitle: The joint comparison is not available right now
compare.notReady: Some requirements for the joint comparison are still missing.

weights.same: You weighted this the same way.

paths.same: You would choose the same first path.
paths.different: In this situation you set different priorities.
paths.open: Not everyone chose a path here – the comparison says nothing about that.

compare.talk: This could be a good point to align your expectations.
compare.closing: The comparison only describes what you stated. It does not assess how well you fit together.
